Name: Klimato
Description: Klimato delivers world-leading food climate data, deep industry expertise, and flexible solutions that help food businesses measure their impact, streamline reporting, and act on clear insights that drive climate reduction. Built specifically for the food industry, our tools and guidance improve reporting accuracy, strengthen carbon reduction strategies, and support credible, data-driven progress.

Name: Eliq
Description:
We help utilities turn energy data into something people actually understand and use.

Eliq started in Sweden in 2016 with a simple goal: to help people make sense of their energy usage. What began as a small team working with a single utility is now a platform used across 15+ markets – supporting millions of households and some of Europe’s most ambitious energy providers.

We’re not here to sell dashboards. We’re here to help utilities stay relevant – by making energy feel less like a black box, and more like something customers can control, learn from, and act on.

That means fewer calls. Lower churn. Smarter operations. Stronger relationships.
But more than anything, it means closing the gap between data and real-life impact.

Name: ZeroMission AB – B Corp certified
Description:
ZeroMission is a Stockholm-based company with a strong set of values and two decades of dedication to climate action. We help businesses and organizations with strategic guidance and practical tools to measure and reduce their climate impact – ensuring your organization stays aligned with global climate goals.

Our sustainability platform, powered by a database of more than 100,000 emission factors, makes it easy to calculate and track your emissions over time.

In addition, we offer climate financing – an effective way to take responsibility for the emissions your organization generates today, while contributing to long-term climate solutions.

Join us in driving innovation and supporting efficient agronomic practices in golf courses and agriculture.

Name: CO2 Improve
Description:
In the field of logistics the IAF has developed a concept: CO2 Improve.
Driven by the rapid growth in attention for sustainable logistics, this logistics concept has been created to lower the CO2 footprint of any company in the  Fashion, Textile and Sports industry. 

CO2 Improve deliver transport CO2 emission calculations and helps fashion-, textile- and sports companies to plan and implement reduction measures to improve their performance. Our emission calculations are accredited and in methodological conformance with the Global Logistics Emissions Council Framework for Logistics Emissions Methodologies (GLEC Framework, compliant with the EN16258, CCWG and ICAO/IATA RP1678).

Name: Venuehub.live
Description:
Smart processes are sustainable processes.
For venues and promoters, time is money – and fragmented workflows cost both. Venuehub digitizes and streamlines the entire planning and booking process, reducing admin load while enabling better decisions for both business and planet.
Our platform supports economically sustainable operations by replacing email threads, spreadsheets, and double bookings with a unified system for venue and tour planning. As a result, venues can focus on revenue-driving activities while also accessing crucial emission data for CSRD compliance – covering Scope 1, 2, and 3.
Venuehub connects operational efficiency with environmental responsibility.
Because real sustainability starts with smarter systems.

Name: Verdatir
Description:
Verdatir is quality infrastructure for environmental data.

An EPD, LCA is only as good as the data underneath it, and AI now generates that data faster than anyone can check it. It might be right or wrong but it does so confidently. Volume of the analysis isn't the constraint anymore quality checking is. 
Verdatir gives judgment scale and reach. We connect to the LCA tools and systems you already use, check each declaration against the PCRs and standards that apply, and flag what a human needs to see, with a full audit trail. The expert always decides. We just let one person's expertise cover far more without thinning out.

Name: Rebellpappor
Description:
Rebellpappor är en grupp vanliga "pappor" som visar vår kärlek och omsorg för våra barn och framtida generationer genom att manifestera för en bättre klimatpolitik. Rebellpapporna samlar pappor och allierade som vill engagera sig för klimatet. ”Rebellpappa” är den som själv identifierar sig med detta begrepp – pappor, farbröder, farföräldrar och alla andra som vill kämpa för barnens framtid är välkomna.

Vi tillhör de 70% av Sveriges befolkning som oroar sig för de kommande klimatförändringarna och vill göra något åt dem. Vi vill bygga en bred, positiv gemenskap, eftersom vi vet att utmaningarna som väntar inte kan tacklas individuellt.

Name: Omnical
Description:
We specialize in enabling the assessment of environmental impacts across key areas such as product design, manufacturing processes, facility management, and supply chain logistics.

Our mission is to drive measurable, positive change by turning climate data into actionable insights. At Omnical, we believe in the transformative power of education and motivation to foster sustainability. Our services are designed to significantly enhance the collection and evaluation of environmental metrics, empowering organizations to make informed decisions.

We are proud to partner with Doconomy, a global leader in transactional impact calculations, to deliver innovative solutions that inspire meaningful progress toward a more sustainable future.

Name: co2koll.se
Description:
Co2koll är klimatverktyget för svenska idrottsklubbar och företag.

Vi gör det enkelt att mäta, tolka och minska era utsläpp. Med några klick får ni en komplett bild av er klimatpåverkan, från fordon och energi till inköp, tjänsteresor och pendling, uppdelad enligt GHG-protokollet (scope 1, 2 och 3) och beräknad med svenska emissionsfaktorer.

För idrottsklubbar är co2koll alltid gratis. Klimatomställningen ska vara tillgänglig för alla föreningar, och vi har byggt sport-specifika beräkningar för bland annat golf, ishockey, simning, fotboll och skidor. Från klippscheman och konstsnötillverkning till bortamatcher och anläggningar.

För företag täcker beräkningen hela verksamheten: basics, energi, fordonsflotta, inköp, avfall, tjänsteresor och pendling. Skicka pendlingsenkät direkt till medarbetarna så räknas deras utsläpp automatiskt in i beräkningen.

Vad ni får:
• Klimatberäkning enligt GHG-protokollet, scope 1–3
• Dashboard med år-för-år-utveckling och kurva mot 2030
• Konkret handlingsplan rangordnad efter potential för CO2-minskning
• Pendlingsenkät, rapporter och länsplaceringar

EU:s klimatlag kräver minst 55 % utsläppsminskning till 2030 jämfört med 1990. Co2koll hjälper er bygga er egen kurva mot den takten, och visar tydligt vad nästa steg är.

Mät, tolka, minska på co2koll.se.
